prompts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit, game UI mockup.
Edit this exact Warline Capture screenshot with ONE extremely localized change: lower-left squad roster. Deliver single full landscape screenshot with identical framing and HUD layout, no board title or outside captions.
Every UI element outside the squad strip is immutable. KEEP all SEVEN command buttons SELECT, MOVE, ATTACK, HOLD, SCAN, SUPPORT, BUILD in exact original single-row positions starting at 43% image width. Preserve their sizes and icons. Keep top resources, ARIA panel, minimap, scene and guidance unchanged. Never shift commands left to fill space.
The squad-card strip is confined to x=0.8%–42.5%, y=78%–98.5%. Cards MUST remain same small size as full cards in reference: approximately 7.4% screen width by20% screen height. NO enlargement or stretching with fewer squads. Left align at x0.8%, y78%. Card art fills card above a narrow name footer, health line. Original portrait style and cyan selected outline. The unused space to the right of remaining card(s), up to SELECT button, must simply reveal existing battlefield scenery. NO background bar, empty card slots, ghost cards, disabled cards, paging arrows, chevrons, scrollbar, headings, or count badge. No extra UI. All cards wholly visible because roster fits.
There is exactly ONE squad available. Show exactly ONE standard-size RIFLE SQUAD portrait card at far bottom-left, selected cyan border. Remove all other squad cards and BOTH scrolling arrows and restore battlefield in their old positions. The remaining card spans only approximately x0.8%–8.2% of screen, not the whole strip. End result has ONE small portrait card lower left, open battlefield gap, then original seven command buttons unchanged.
